name: Troas
brief: A city in Asia Minor, visited by Paul
short: Troas, a city in Asia Minor, where Paul had a vision of a man urging him to come to Macedonia, and where he later preached and raised Eutychus from the dead (<ref="Act.16.8-11; 20:5-12; 2Cor. 2:12; 2Tim. 4:13">Act.16.8-11; 20:5-12; 2Cor. 2:12; 2Tim. 4:13</ref>).
